lines.trans: Stop tying yourself in knots, alright? Even a fool can see how Xiaogu feels.
That night in the office, even when her suitor pulled out all the stops, she never left your side.

words.gram: Meaning: pull out all the stops.

lines.trans: What big move did he pull?
Everyone on night duty told me that fellow showed up at the editorial office late that night.
Probably right while you were asleep, he presented Xiaogu with a ring.
Desperation drove him to pull a stunt like that—he stopped just short of kneeling to her.
With so much happening lately, I actually forgot all about him.
Good riddance if you forgot—you do not need to care about him at all.
The way I see it, Xiaogu does not like him one bit.
